title: feat(scenarios): score the seven capability tags the mid-tier cards declare and the closed tag table left unscored
body:
Fixes #30984
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景评分器的封闭能力标签表新增 7 行(公式字段、校验规则、多级审批、动态审批人、行级安全、报表、AI 可调用动作),六张中阶卡声明的这 7 个标签不再显示 `unscored`。
- 为什么改:中阶卡正是为考这些能力而写,原先 Build 半场完全不检查它们,得分说明不了 app 是否真有卡片要考的能力。
- 风险与回滚:只影响私有 devx 包 `@objectstack/scenarios` 的评分,不发布;新增声明依赖 `@objectstack/formula`(本就在 full 评分入口的依赖闭包内);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`(7 行新规则,风险最高的是 `rowSecurityGap` 与 `approvalSequence`)、`src/score/scenario-expressions.ts`(「能编译」一律问平台自己的校验器)、`test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`,预期 23 个文件全绿;其中 `the library` 一组证明六张中阶卡上这 7 个标签都被评分(空 build 上为 `fail`,不是 `unscored`)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Seven rows join `CAPABILITY_TAG_CHECKS`, one per tag the mid-tier cards declare and the closed table left unscored. Each row reads the built artifact through the platform's own schemas and helpers, and each carries the table's discrimination test: the rich build passes it, and one defect per stated reason fails exactly that tag. No area prefix is matched anywhere.

| Tag | Checks | Read through |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `records-forms.formula-field` | `computed-field-exists`; per computed field `formula:OBJECT.FIELD->compiles` | `validateExpression('value', …)` at `record` scope over the object's declared and injected columns (`resolveInjectedSystemColumns`) and declared field types, `traversalHydration` on: the validator `os build` runs on a formula |
| `records-forms.validation-rule` | per rule with a predicate `validation:OBJECT.RULE->compiles` (`condition`, a conditional rule's `when`, nested `then` / `otherwise` rules); `validation-rule-binds-expected-object` (an active, `severity: 'error'` rule on an object the card names) | `validateExpression('predicate', …)`, same hint |
| `approvals.multi-step-approval` | `multi-step-approval-binds-expected-object`: a flow bound to a card-named object the build carries, where a second Approval node follows the first on its `approve` branch | `APPROVAL_NODE_TYPE`, `APPROVAL_BRANCH_LABELS`; the walk mirrors the engine's `traverseNext` (approve-labelled out-edges, or every out-edge when none is labelled; never `fault`) |
| `approvals.dynamic-approver-routing` | per record-routed approver `approver:FLOW.NODE[i]->routes`; `dynamic-approver-binds-expected-object` | `APPROVER_VALUE_BINDINGS` sources `trigger-field` / `auto` / `expression` are record-routed; a `field` (or a `manager`'s subject: its `value` field, else `owner_id`, as plugin-approvals resolves it) must hold a user (`referenceTargetOf`, injected columns via `injectedSystemColumnDefs`); an `expression` must parse over `APPROVER_EXPRESSION_ROOTS` (`collectCelRootIdentifiers`) |
| `access-security.row-level-security` | per scoped object `row-level-security:OBJECT->enforced`, for every persona that scopes it | row-scope's three routes, each held to enforce: private (`effectiveSharingModel`); `controlled_by_parent` only when its master (`controlledByParentMasterOf`) is itself kept so for that persona; or a read policy on the persona's set. Every applicable read policy must lower to a filter (`isSupportedRlsExpression`) |
| `dashboards.report` | per report `report:NAME->resolves` (its dataset exists and declares every selected measure and dimension; a joined report per block); `report-binds-expected-object` (a report's dataset `object` is card-named) | `ReportSchema` `dataset` / `values` / `rows` / `columns` / `blocks`, `DatasetSchema` `object` / `measures` / `dimensions` (ADR-0021) |
| `ai.agent-actions` | the checks `gradeAgentActions` runs for `run.agentActions` (exists, `ai.exposed`, `ai.requiresConfirmation` where `confirm`) | unchanged reader, so the tag and the agent-action half judge an action by one rule |

Where measurement sharpened the card's suggested checks (the suggestions were not rulings):

- **Formula field accepts a stored computed field.** The spec's `expression` on a non-`formula` field is computed and stored "so a `summary` can roll the column up"; a `formula` field is virtual. The mid-tier cards sum computed line amounts in roll-ups, so a faithful build writes the stored kind, and a `type: 'formula'`-only check would fail it.
- **"Compiles" is the shared validator's verdict:** CEL syntax, `record.FIELD` column existence and the one-hop traversal rule. The build's further site rules over the same source (null guards, type soundness under the site's fault outcome, a hop into a field the target lacks, `label()` over an optionless field) are not re-run; `scenario-expressions.ts` names that gap in its header.
- **Validation rule:** an advisory severity lets the write through, so the binding check counts an active `severity: 'error'` rule; a rule with no predicate (state machine, format, JSON schema) counts toward the binding and has nothing to compile.
- **Row-level security keeps row-scope's routes, as the card asks (#30883 item 4 as corrected).** The platform's own checklist item titled "Row-level security" (`access-security.rls-both-sides`) is an OWD-private object, so a private route is RLS in this platform's vocabulary. What the row adds over row-scope is enforcement: a read policy whose `using` does not lower matches no row (the spec's own `using` description), and a scoped detail whose master the persona reads in full keeps nothing to it. Both are pinned as cases where row-scope passes and this row fails.
- **Dynamic routing counts `manager`.** plugin-approvals resolves it from the record (`record[value] ?? record.owner_id`), so it is read off the request; every directory or catalog binding (user, position, team, department, queue, membership tier) is the same slate for every request and does not count.
- **Report means a `report` item.** A report binds a dataset, never an object, so the binding is judged through the dataset's `object`. A dashboard widget is the sibling tag `dashboards.widget-measures`.

Outside the claim's named surface, each the minimum the change needs:

- `packages/qa/scenarios/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` (+3 lines): `@objectstack/formula` declared, because the expression verdicts are its functions. It was already in the `./score/full` runtime graph (objectql and plugin-sharing depend on it); the narrow `./score` entry does not reach it (`test/build/narrow-score-graph.test.ts` stays green).
- `packages/qa/scenarios/vitest.config.ts`: one anchored alias so the tests judge the formula source in this checkout (`pnpm check:test-source-alias` went red without it).
- `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`: the closed-table section lists the seven rows (a different hunk from the tier lines #31091 landed).

No changeset: `@objectstack/scenarios` is `private: true` and nothing in this diff ships from a released package, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

`test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`:

- The rich build gains a `formula` field, a script validation rule, a two-step approval (a `field` approver over a `user` field, then a position), a dataset dimension and a report. `passes every row of the table` now covers all 16 rows at score 1.
- `TAG_DEGRADATIONS` adds 19 one-defect cases for the seven rows; `ALSO_FAILS` names the five defects that break a second row by construction (the approval flow's three binding defects take the steps and the routed approver along; a public scoped object fails both row tags).
- Per-row suites: a stored computed field counts; two hops refused, one accepted; a `formula` field with no expression fails; a conditional rule's nested predicate is judged; a state machine binds with nothing to compile; a decision between steps is followed, an unlabelled approve edge is walked as the engine walks it, alternative branches are not steps; `manager` with and without a `value`, `expression` over `current` passes and over `record` or unparseable fails, seven fixed approver kinds count nothing; RLS fails where row-scope passes (a non-lowering policy, on a public and a private object; a scoped detail whose master is read in full); a joined report draws per block; a report with no dataset fails; the agent-actions tag carries exactly the agent-action checks.
- `the library`: loads `docs/qa/scenarios/` through the loader; each of the seven has a row and is declared by a card; on every card that declares one, an empty build grades it `fail`, never `unscored`.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per tested behaviour, via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; tests import src, so no build leg)</summary>

| Mutation | Red | Restore |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `rowSecurityGap`: the non-lowering policy refusal disabled | 1: RLS fails where row-scope passes | blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |
| `approvalSequence`: the approve-label filter dropped (every out-edge walked) | 1: second approval on the reject branch | blob == HEAD |
| `recordExpressionRefusal`: the column list removed from the hint | 3: formula / rule over a missing field, nested conditional predicate | blob == HEAD |
| `approverRouteRefusal`: the holds-a-user test forced true | 3: non-user field, missing field, `manager` over a non-user field | blob == HEAD |

The first attempt at the second mutation was refused by the tool (the replacement text already occurred inside the anchor, so the count could not prove the write); it ran nothing and was redone with a distinct replacement.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ai.agent-actions` counts the agent-action checks under the tag as well, as `dashboards.widget-measures` already counts the measure checks `expect` runs; a card carrying the tag weighs a missing action twice in the Build total.
- Card-side observation, not filed (read only): the five cards tagged `dashboards.report` ask for "a report of …" while `expect.dashboards` names that report as a dashboard the build prompt never names, and `leave_balances` tags the same wording `dashboards.widget-measures`.
- The row-scope row does not ask whether a read policy lowers; that is now this PR's RLS row's question, and an artifact `os build` wrote cannot carry one that does not (`rls-predicate-unenforceable` refuses it).

## Verification

All at head `37d8ec1c` (origin/main `b6315733` merged, #31091 included; whole tree rebuilt first: turbo 119/119, 73 cached).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 62 commands derived; all 62 run, each exit code captured before any pipe: **62 exit 0**. `--ran` with the recorded codes: "62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a derived zero).
- `pnpm check:test-source-alias` was red on the first run (`@objectstack/formula` resolved to `dist/` in the tests); fixed by the alias in `vitest.config.ts`, green at this head.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET before the whole-tree build; at this head: 116 require entry points across 71 packages load.
- Not run locally, CI's: the repo-wide lint scan, the Test Core / Build Core / type-check lanes, the dogfood batteries (no `!` in the title, Clause-② no).
